open Lean

def isAJ (m : Name) : Bool := (`AlgebraicJacobian).isPrefixOf m

def seeds : List Name := [
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IsTrimmedTrivializing,
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.exists_isTrimmedTrivializing,
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ratio_agree,
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.exists_overlapUnit,
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.selCochain,
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.pairCochain,
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.isTrimmedTrivializing_pairCochain,
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.pairCochain_pairUnit_at,
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.pairCochain_conj,
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.pairCochain_conj_inv,
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.twoChartClassHom_surjOn_of_chartTrivial,
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.cocycleValueOn,
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.cocycleValueOn_trans,
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.cocycleValueOn_self,
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.cocycleValueOn_symm,
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.normCochain,
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.normCochain_conj,
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.unitsRestrict_mixedValue,
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.cocycleValueOn_eq_candidate,
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.cocycleValueOn_base_eq_twoChartPairUnit,
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.twoChartCocycle_isCohomologous,
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.twoChartClassHom_mk_range,
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.twoChartClass_mk_range
]

unsafe def run : CoreM Unit := do
  let env ← getEnv
  let mut stack : List Name := seeds
  let mut visited : NameSet := {}
  let mut ajdecls : Array (Name × Name) := #[]
  let mut missing : Array Name := #[]
  while !stack.isEmpty do
    let n := stack.head!
    stack := stack.tail!
    if visited.contains n then continue
    visited := visited.insert n
    match env.find? n with
    | none => missing := missing.push n
    | some ci =>
      match env.getModuleFor? n with
      | none => pure ()
      | some mod =>
        if isAJ mod then
          ajdecls := ajdecls.push (mod, n)
          let mut cs : NameSet := {}
          cs := ci.type.getUsedConstants.foldl (·.insert ·) cs
          match ci with
          | .thmInfo t => cs := t.value.getUsedConstants.foldl (·.insert ·) cs
          | .defnInfo d => cs := d.value.getUsedConstants.foldl (·.insert ·) cs
          | .opaqueInfo d => cs := d.value.getUsedConstants.foldl (·.insert ·) cs
          | _ => pure ()
          for c in cs.toList do
            if !visited.contains c then stack := c :: stack
  IO.println s!"MISSINGSEEDS\t{missing.size}\t{missing.toList}"
  IO.println s!"AJCOUNT\t{ajdecls.size}"
  for (m, n) in ajdecls do
    IO.println s!"D\t{m}\t{n}"

**AJC already has the algebra layer of the ε-kernel computation, natively.** `Picard/Pic0DualNumberCocycle.lean` (1,153 lines, sorry-free) §6 is described in its own docstring as "the **two-chart Čech unit-cocycle engine**, the pure-algebra heart of the Kleiman §5 Thm 5.11 cocycle leg", with `DualNumber.cechCoboundaryUnits ρ₁ ρ₂` the coboundary subgroup `im(ρ₁ˣ)·im(ρ₂ˣ) ≤ Bˣ` and `DualNumber.truncExpCechKernelAddEquiv : B ⧸ (ρ₁(A₁) + ρ₂(A₂)) ≃+ ker(Ȟ¹ˣ(B[ε]) → Ȟ¹ˣ(B))`. What AJC lacks is not the algebra — it is Layer A, the scheme-side cocycle-to-`CechPic` geometry that connects that quotient to a Picard group.
